items.title: Rename all 8 koala-* signature salts to lattice-* via the worktree binary
items.context: koala-review-integrity-v1, koala-review-pass-integrity-v1, koala-review-run-integrity-v1, koala-review-run-workspace-binding-v1, koala-review-scope-binding-v1, koala-scope-check-integrity-v1, koala-finding-integrity-v1, koala-story-store in core/guard-utils.ts, machine.ts, process-fact-registry.ts, reviewer-status.ts, handlers/story-review.ts, canonical-story.ts, finding-verify.ts, review-run.ts, review-scope-binding.ts, handlers/scope-check.ts (+ their smokes). Change the literal salt VALUE; producers and consumers move together; sign this story's gates with the worktree binary.

happy.desc: git grep all 8 old koala-* salt strings (koala-review-integrity-v1, koala-review-pass-integrity-v1, koala-review-run-integrity-v1, koala-review-run-workspace-binding-v1, koala-review-scope-binding-v1, koala-scope-check-integrity-v1, koala-finding-integrity-v1, koala-story-store) in packages/*/src -> zero hits; WHY: confirms literal salt values are fully removed

git grep all 8 new lattice-* salt strings (lattice-review-integrity-v1, lattice-review-pass-integrity-v1, etc.) in the same files -> each appears exactly where its koala- predecessor did; WHY: confirms rename happened, not just deletion

run the existing smoke tests that exercise signature verification (guard-utils, machine, process-fact-registry, reviewer-status, story-review, canonical-story, finding-verify, review-run, review-scope-binding, scope-check smokes) -> all pass; WHY: producers and consumers use the same new salt, signatures still verify end-to-end

edge.desc: sign a gate artifact with the worktree binary after the rename, then verify it with the same binary -> signature valid; WHY: ensures the worktree build itself uses the new salts consistently (no stale dist cache)

check that no mixed old+new salt pair exists in any single file (e.g. producer writes koala-* but consumer reads lattice-*) -> zero mixed pairs; WHY: partial rename is worse than no rename (silent signature rejection)

adversarial.desc: verify that the residue-gate self-identifiers (KOALA_RESIDUE_* in review-preflight.ts) were NOT renamed by this item -- they must still say koala -> grep confirms KOALA_RESIDUE_* unchanged; WHY: renaming the gate that detects koala residue would break the residue gate itself (story 4 scope)
attempt to verify an artifact signed with the OLD koala-* salt using the new binary -> verification fails (rejects old salt); WHY: ensures no backward-compat path that silently accepts old signatures

check .lattice/story/ files are untouched (no salt rename leaked into story metadata or persisted evidence) -> git diff shows zero changes in .lattice/story/; WHY: story metadata uses different serialization; touching it would corrupt audit trail

items.title: Delete the legacy-koala detection (drop old-install handling)
items.context: core/managed-assets.ts excluded-path entries bin/koala.js / bin/koala-codex.js / .lattice-codex/koala.json (the denylist for old koala binaries); the @koala-agent old-global-install detection in flow-stability-smoke.ts / worktree-repair-smoke.ts / lattice-only-absence-smoke.ts. Remove the detection and its now-moot absence assertions; no old-koala migration support kept.

happy.desc: git grep bin/koala.js and bin/koala-codex.js in core/managed-assets.ts -> zero hits; the excluded-path denylist entries are removed; WHY: confirms legacy binary denylist is deleted
git grep @koala-agent in packages/*/src -> zero hits; the old-global-install detection logic is gone; WHY: confirms old-install migration detection removed

flow-stability-smoke.ts, worktree-repair-smoke.ts, lattice-only-absence-smoke.ts still compile and pass after removing the @koala-agent absence assertions -> npm test passes for those files; WHY: deletion of moot assertions must not break the rest of the smoke

edge.desc: grep for .lattice-codex/koala.json in managed-assets.ts -> zero hits; WHY: this was part of the denylist alongside the binaries and must also be removed

grep for isKoalaSelfRepoBootstrap in packages/*/src -> zero hits OR renamed to lattice equivalent; WHY: if this function was load-bearing self-repo detection, it must be renamed not silently deleted (story understanding unknown #1)

adversarial.desc: verify that removing the absence assertions did not remove UNRELATED assertions from the same smoke files -- diff the smoke files and confirm only koala-related lines were deleted; WHY: bulk deletion can accidentally strip genuine test coverage

verify managed-assets.ts still has its non-koala excluded-path entries intact after the koala entries are removed -> the array still contains its other legitimate entries; WHY: deleting array entries can cause off-by-one or accidentally remove neighbors

items.title: Clean the remaining koala-codex / koala-agent and stray koala literals in packages/*/src
items.context: The ~7 files with koala-codex/koala-agent references not covered above, plus any other stray koala comment/string in packages/*/src, except the residue-gate self-identifiers (KOALA_RESIDUE_* in handlers/review-preflight.ts) which are story 4.

happy.desc: git grep -i koala-codex in packages/*/src -> zero hits; WHY: all koala-codex references cleaned
git grep -i koala-agent in packages/*/src -> zero hits (after CHK-002 also removes its portion); WHY: all koala-agent references cleaned
git grep -i koala -- packages/*/src -> only review-preflight.ts KOALA_RESIDUE_* lines remain; WHY: comprehensive stray-literal sweep is done, only story-4 deferred identifiers survive

edge.desc: grep for koala in string literals AND comments (not just identifiers) across packages/*/src -> only KOALA_RESIDUE_* in review-preflight.ts; WHY: comments containing koala are also in-scope for this story (they leak brand name)

check that renamed references (koala->lattice) in comments/strings still make semantic sense after mechanical replacement -- no broken URLs, no nonsensical text; WHY: blind find-replace can produce gibberish (e.g. lattice-codex where it was a proper noun reference)

adversarial.desc: verify docs/experiments/ and .lattice/story/ directories have zero changes from this item -> git diff shows no modifications there; WHY: story description explicitly says docs/experiments and .lattice/story are untouched; cleaning stray literals must not leak into documentation or story metadata

verify that no functional logic was removed alongside stray koala literals -- diff each changed file and confirm only string/comment tokens changed, not control flow; WHY: a stray literal cleanup must be cosmetic, not behavioral

items.title: Keep build/suite/gate green; confirm zero koala except the deferred gate self-ID
items.context: npx tsc --noEmit clean; packages/main suite green (skip pre-existing fails cli-json-stdout/field-regression/english-open-source-surface/prompt-token-cost); node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs still PASS + self-test. Final: git grep -i koala -- 'packages/*/src/**' returns ONLY review-preflight.ts KOALA_RESIDUE_* (story 4); zero salts/legacy-detection/koala-codex/koala-agent remain; docs/experiments and .lattice/story untouched.

happy.desc: npx tsc --noEmit -> exit 0, zero type errors; WHY: build must be clean after all renames/deletions
npm test (packages/main suite, skipping pre-existing fails cli-json-stdout/field-regression/english-open-source-surface/prompt-token-cost) -> all non-skipped tests pass; WHY: suite must remain green
node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs -> PASS; WHY: the residue gate itself must still function (it detects unauthorized koala references)
git grep -i koala -- packages/*/src -> output contains ONLY review-preflight.ts KOALA_RESIDUE_* lines; WHY: the acceptance criterion -- zero koala except deferred gate self-ID

edge.desc: run verify-koala-residue.mjs self-test mode -> self-test passes; WHY: the gate must be able to detect a future koala reintroduction (self-test injects a fake violation and checks the gate catches it)

git grep -i koala -- docs/ experiments/ -> hits are allowed (docs are out of scope) but verify they exist as expected baseline; WHY: ensures the grep scope boundary is correctly drawn at packages/*/src

adversarial.desc: temporarily inject a koala-* salt string into a packages/*/src file, run verify-koala-residue.mjs -> gate FAILS (detects the injection); then revert; WHY: proves the residue gate is still functional after all the renames -- it would catch a regression

verify .lattice/story/ files are unchanged by the entire story (across all CHK items) -> git diff .lattice/story/ shows no modifications to story metadata; WHY: story metadata must not be collateral damage

verify no koala-* salt strings appear in the built dist/ output (if dist is committed) -> grep the dist for old salts returns zero; WHY: a stale dist cache could re-introduce old salts at runtime even if source is clean

items.title: Rename koala config fields/filenames to lattice (idleKoala, koala.config.json, koalaConfig)
items.context: ~25 hits: the idleKoala config field, koala.config.json filename references, koalaConfig identifiers in packages/*/src. Rename to lattice-named equivalents; under no-compat, do NOT keep a koala.config.json read-fallback — old koala-named config is not migrated (OSS users start fresh).

happy.desc: git grep idleKoala in packages/*/src -> zero hits; replacement field (idleLattice or equivalent) exists; WHY: config field renamed, not just deleted
git grep koala.config.json in packages/*/src -> zero hits; replacement filename (lattice.config.json or equivalent) exists in the same code paths; WHY: filename reference renamed
git grep koalaConfig in packages/*/src -> zero hits; replacement identifier (latticeConfig or equivalent) exists; WHY: identifier renamed

edge.desc: verify NO read-fallback for koala.config.json exists (no code that tries lattice.config.json then falls back to koala.config.json) -> grep for both filenames in same function shows no fallback; WHY: story explicitly says no-compat, old config is not migrated

verify the config schema/type definitions are updated to use the new field names -> TypeScript interfaces reference idleLattice (or equivalent), not idleKoala; WHY: type definitions must match runtime field names

adversarial.desc: search for any koala substring in config-related files (case-insensitive) that might have been missed by the targeted renames -> zero hits outside KOALA_RESIDUE_*; WHY: there may be derivative identifiers (e.g. parseKoalaConfig, KOALA_CONFIG_PATH) not captured by the three named targets

verify that test fixtures and smoke tests that previously referenced idleKoala/koala.config.json/koalaConfig have been updated to use the new names -> tests still pass, no test is asserting the OLD name; WHY: a test asserting the old name would pass vacuously if the feature under test was deleted rather than renamed

items.title: Rename .koala/ runtime path references to the lattice runtime dir
items.context: ~22 hits: .koala/ runtime path string literals/comments (e.g. tool-status.ts .koala/activity.jsonl). Point them at the lattice runtime dir (.lattice/ or the canonical path). Under no-compat, existing .koala/ data is NOT migrated (orphaned for any old install; OSS users start fresh). Verify no code still WRITES to .koala/.

happy.desc: git grep \.koala/ in packages/*/src -> zero hits; all .koala/ path references replaced with .lattice/ (or canonical runtime dir); WHY: confirms the path rename is complete
grep for the new .lattice/ path references in the same files that previously had .koala/ -> each file has its replacement; WHY: confirms rename, not just deletion of path references
code that READS from the runtime dir (e.g. activity.jsonl, tool-status) uses .lattice/ path -> unit/smoke tests pass; WHY: reads from the new path must work

edge.desc: verify no code still WRITES to .koala/ -- grep for .koala in combination with write/create/append/writeFile/fs.write patterns -> zero hits; WHY: a missed write would silently split runtime data between .koala/ and .lattice/, causing data loss (story understanding unknown #3)

verify path references in COMMENTS are also updated (not just string literals) -> grep for .koala in all comment patterns returns zero; WHY: stale comments mislead future developers about the actual runtime path

adversarial.desc: verify that no backward-compat migration from .koala/ to .lattice/ was added (no code that copies/moves .koala/* to .lattice/*) -> zero migration logic exists; WHY: story explicitly says no-compat, existing .koala/ data is orphaned, OSS users start fresh

verify .koala/ does not appear in any path-construction helper or constant (e.g. RUNTIME_DIR, getDataDir) that could dynamically produce .koala/ paths even if the literal is not grep-visible -> inspect the path constants and confirm they reference .lattice/; WHY: a constant like KOALA_DIR = ".koala" renamed only at usage sites but not at definition would still produce .koala/ paths at runtime

check that no test fixture or mock creates a .koala/ directory or references it in expected output -> grep test files for .koala -> zero hits outside KOALA_RESIDUE_*; WHY: test fixtures asserting .koala/ paths would either fail (good) or mask a missed rename (bad if the test itself was deleted)

items.title: Literal zero: delete legacy-koala cleanup + rename and flip the residue gate to lattice
items.context: Delete the ~55 remaining legacy-koala-cleanup lines (cli-init removePathIfExists .claude/skills/koala; managed-assets Koala-brand detection) and remove/adapt the brand-absence-assertion tests. Rename the residue gate to lattice: KOALA_RESIDUE_* in handlers/review-preflight.ts, the koala-residue name in cli-prompts.ts, the script path, and scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs -> verify-lattice-residue.mjs + its internals; FLIP it to zero-tolerance (any koala in SCAN_ROOTS = FAIL). Acceptance: git grep -i koala -- packages/*/src = 0 (literal zero); the renamed lattice-residue gate PASSes zero-tolerance over packages/*/src. Gate does NOT scan docs/, so docs koala is unaffected.

verificationEvidence.note: Exit 1 (no matches) confirms literal zero koala references in product runtime source
Exit 0 PASS confirms the renamed+flipped zero-tolerance gate passes over the now-clean packages/*/src surface
